inverse-trig.def: The inverse sine, inverse cosine and inverse tangent functions, $\sin^{-1} x$, $\cos^{-1} x$ and $\tan^{-1} x$ (also written $\arcsin x$, $\arccos x$, $\arctan x$). Each takes a ratio and returns an angle: $\sin^{-1}$ and $\tan^{-1}$ in $\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]$ (open for tangent), $\cos^{-1}$ in $[0, \pi]$. They are inverses, not reciprocals.
